title: The Company Years, 1811-1830
description: From Selkirk's grant to the Governor's economies: the blockade, the Pemmican War, Seven Oaks, the lawless years, the union of the companies and what Simpson made of it. The dated history is fixed or pressed on the world; the brigades on the rivers answer to what the world does.

beats.title: The Continental Blockade holds the fur market down
Lord Selkirk's grant of Assiniboia (the Red River Colony)

happens.subject: Lord Selkirk's grant
happens.text: The Committee has granted Lord Selkirk a hundred and sixteen thousand square miles on the Red River for a settlement. Settlers will come out by the Bay. Give them every assistance; the Canadians will not like it.

beats.title: Governor Macdonell's settlers winter at York Factory

happens.why: a hundred mouths to feed at the Factory

happens.subject: The Selkirk settlers
happens.text: Governor Macdonell's party is landed at the Factory with the season too far gone to push inland. Winter them as you can, and let them see the Company is a good neighbour. They go up in the spring.

beats.title: War between Britain and the United States

happens.subject: war with the Americans
happens.text: The Americans have declared war. Michilimackinac is in danger and the canoes may be wanted for the King's service.

happens.subject: the American war
happens.text: Britain is at war with the United States. The ship may be late; ration accordingly.

beats.title: The first settlers reach the Forks

happens.why: a colony on the buffalo ground

happens.subject: strangers at the Forks
happens.text: Macdonell's people have put down their stakes at the Forks, on the very road of our provision brigades. Mr. McGillivray will want to hear of it.

beats.title: Astor's Fort Astoria sold to the North West Company

happens.subject: Astoria is ours
happens.text: Astor's men on the Columbia have sold out to us. Fort Astoria is Fort George now, and many of his clerks are Nor'Westers.

beats.title: The war on the Lakes slows the Montreal canoes

then.text: Word from the Lakes: the war has the Montreal traffic stopped at every carrying place, and powder goes to the King's service first.

beats.title: Governor Macdonell's Pemmican Proclamation
beats.rumour: They say the governor at the Forks means to forbid any pemmican to leave the colony.

pressure.why: word that the colony's governor means to stop the pemmican

happens.subject: the Pemmican Proclamation
happens.text: Macdonell has forbidden any provisions to leave the colony's lands. Our brigades eat pemmican or they do not run. The partners will not stand it.

happens.subject: the governor's proclamation
happens.text: Governor Macdonell has proclaimed that no pemmican may be taken out of Assiniboia. The Nor'Westers are furious; keep your people close.

beats.title: Peace in Europe: the fur market reopens

happens.subject: peace
happens.text: Bonaparte is beaten and the Continent is open again. Furs will sell; the Committee expects returns to answer.

beats.title: The blockade lifts and the outfit comes freely

happens.text: Peace in Europe, and a full outfit at last: the shelves at York Factory and Fort William are stocked as they have not been in years.

beats.title: The Proclamation empties the canoes' provisions

then.why: the canoes go hungry while the colony holds the pemmican

then.text: The Saskatchewan canoes are on short commons for the third summer running: the Proclamation is starving the brigades, and the partners are saying so.

else.text: Pemmican is short on the Saskatchewan: the canoes lie up to hunt.

beats.title: The Red River Colony attacked and dispersed
beats.rumour: The Metis talk of driving the settlers from the Forks before another winter.

pressure.why: the Metis gathering against the colony

happens.subject: the colony broken up
happens.text: The settlers at Red River have been driven off and their houses burned. Some are coming down to the Bay.

beats.title: Colin Robertson brings the settlers back to the Forks
beats.rumour: Robertson is said to be gathering the scattered colonists at Norway House.

happens.why: the settlers return, and with them the quarrel

happens.subject: the settlers return
happens.text: Mr. Robertson has brought the colonists back from Norway House and put up Fort Douglas. Governor Semple comes out in the autumn.

beats.title: The Battle of Seven Oaks: Governor Semple and twenty colonists killed
beats.rumour: Grant's riders are gathering on the Assiniboine, and the colony's governor is on the road out from Fort Douglas.

pressure.why: Cuthbert Grant's riders on the Assiniboine

happens.subject: Seven Oaks
happens.text: Governor Semple is dead with twenty of the colonists, shot down at Seven Oaks by Grant's half-breeds. The colony is gone.

happens.subject: Seven Oaks
happens.text: Grant's people met Semple at Seven Oaks. Semple is dead and the colony scattered. There will be a reckoning for this in Montreal.

on_cancel.text: The spring of 1816 passes quietly on the Assiniboine. Whatever was gathering has gone home.

beats.title: Lord Selkirk marches on Fort William and arrests the partners
beats.rumour: Word is Lord Selkirk has hired soldiers for the north and means to come up the lakes.

happens.subject: Fort William taken
happens.text: Selkirk came up the lakes with his de Meurons and took Fort William. McGillivray and the partners are under arrest.

beats.title: Selkirk's soldiers hold Fort William

happens.text: Lord Selkirk's soldiers hold Fort William. The Montreal canoes are stood down and the stores are under guard.

then.text: Fort William is given back to the partners, with its stores a good deal lighter.

beats.title: Selkirk's treaty with the Saulteaux and Cree chiefs
beats.rumour: Lord Selkirk is said to be meeting the chiefs at Red River.

happens.why: Selkirk makes his peace with the chiefs

happens.subject: the treaty
happens.text: Lord Selkirk has made a treaty with the chiefs of the Saulteaux and the Cree for the land along the Red and the Assiniboine. The Company will hold that the land is its own to give.

beats.title: The trials at York in Upper Canada
beats.rumour: The men taken at Fort William are to be tried in Upper Canada.

happens.why: the courts of Upper Canada acquit the Nor'Westers

happens.subject: the trials
happens.text: The Canadian courts have acquitted every man tried for Seven Oaks. The Committee says nothing aloud and a good deal in private.

beats.title: The lawless years: the interior war of 1818
The lawless years: the interior war of 1819
The lawless years: the interior war of 1820
The interior war reaches the brigades
beats.rumour: Shots are said to have been heard along the brigade roads.

happens.why: an incident on the brigade roads

do.text: A rumour of shots at a carrying place; nothing came of it this time.

beats.title: Grand Rapids: Nor'Westers seize the Company's boats
beats.rumour: The Nor'Westers mean to hold Grand Rapids against the Company's boats.

happens.text: The Nor'Westers have seized the Company's boats at Grand Rapids. The York brigade's goods are in their hands.

beats.title: The Earl of Selkirk dies at Pau
beats.rumour: Lord Selkirk is failing, they say, in the south of France.

happens.subject: Lord Selkirk
happens.text: Lord Selkirk is dead in the south of France, worn out and ruined by his lawsuits. The colony has lost its friend, and the Committee has lost a troublesome one.

beats.title: The union of the Hudson's Bay and North West Companies
beats.rumour: There is talk in London and in Montreal of a union of the two companies.

happens.subject: the union of the companies
happens.text: The Company and the North West Company are joined under the Company's charter. Mr. George Simpson will govern the Northern Department. Expect economies.

happens.subject: the coalition
happens.text: It is done: the North West Company goes into the Hudson's Bay Company. The wintering partners are to be chief factors and chief traders. Many of the men will be let go.

beats.title: The North West Company's canoes are stood down

happens.text: The two companies are one. The canoes are stood down; the brigades will run under a single flag.

beats.title: The first council of the Northern Department at York Factory
beats.rumour: Mr. Simpson is to hold a council of the chief factors at the Factory.

happens.subject: Mr. Simpson's council
happens.text: The chief factors and traders met at the Factory and Mr. Simpson gave out the new establishments. Posts that do not pay are to be shut, canoe men let go, and the York boats made to do the work of the Montreal canoes.

beats.title: Retrenchment: the voyageurs are discharged
beats.rumour: It is said the Nor'Westers' voyageurs are to be paid off.

happens.text: Half the old North West engages are discharged at Fort William and the Bas de la Riviere. Some will go to the Red River; some will go to the Americans.

beats.title: Simpson crosses to the Columbia and the Company takes the Pacific slope
beats.rumour: Simpson is said to mean to cross the mountains to the Columbia.

happens.subject: the Columbia
happens.text: Governor Simpson has gone over the mountains to the Columbia and means to move the depot up the river to a new post, to be called Fort Vancouver. The Americans are to be shut out by the Company's own thoroughness: no beaver left to trap on the frontier.

beats.title: The great flood at Red River
beats.rumour: The snow was deep in the north this winter, and the Red River is rising.

then.why: the Red River in flood, in a hard year

happens.subject: the flood
happens.text: The Red River has risen over the colony and carried off the houses and the crops. Some of the settlers are leaving for the States; most will build again on the higher ground.

then.text: A bad year for the Company, a worse one for the settlers: the flood has found a colony already short of everything.

beats.title: The Company without a rival

happens.why: no rival left in the country

happens.subject: no rival
happens.text: With the Canadians gone and the Americans kept off the Columbia, the Company has the country to itself. The Committee asks that the Factor remember what that implies about his Indians' prices.

beats.title: The ship from London, 1812

happens.subject: the ship, 1812
happens.text: The Committee has read the returns and is not pleased with the state of the interior.

then.text: The ship brings a hard letter this year.

beats.title: The year's reckoning
The Committee loses patience

on_awaken.text: A long letter has come from Fenchurch Street, and nobody will say what is in it.

happens.subject: your conduct of the trade
happens.text: The Committee is not satisfied. The quota is cut and the price paid reduced until returns improve.

on_cancel.text: The Committee's temper has improved with the returns.

beats.title: The York boats are late for the ship
beats.rumour: The York boats are not yet in.

on_awaken.text: The York boats are overdue and the ship is nearly due: the Factor walks the wharf at all hours.

happens.text: The boats are still not in. The ship will go home light and the Committee will hear it from the Factor.

on_resolve.text: The York boats are in at last, a little late and none the worse.

beats.title: A boat lost on the road, and London hears of it

happens.subject: Boats lost on the road
happens.text: A boat has gone down with its pieces on the way, and men with it. The returns will be short this summer, and the Committee will want to know why.

beats.title: The Athabasca brigade winters on the road

happens.text: The Athabasca brigade could not make the Methye Portage before the freeze, and the men winter where they stand. Fort Chipewyan will go short.

beats.title: Edmonton House has nothing to trade

happens.text: Edmonton House has nothing left on its shelves, and the Piegans are taking their furs next door to Fort Augustus.

beats.title: Both companies remember who kept the peace
beats.rumour: People at both posts say you spoke for peace, and that it is not forgotten.

happens.text: Both companies' people speak of the truce as the one sensible thing done this year.

beats.title: The raid is the talk of both posts
beats.rumour: The raid you went out on is the talk of both posts, and not kindly.

happens.subject: the raid on the Bay
happens.text: The Bay's people have been seen breaking into a store. The partners want it answered, and will not be told it was only one man's doing.

beats.title: The York boats have a steadier hand

happens.text: The Factor remarks that the boats come in steadier since you took to riding them.
